title: Modern Country Album Cover Design
coreRelationships: Subject offset to the left creates a visual void for the graphic element on the right.
The circular frame of the logo acts as a containment field for high-contrast typography.
The cool teal tones in the clothing and graphic elements unify the composition against the warm skin tones.
A shallow depth of field separates the subject from the bright, overexposed background.
reuseFormula: Portrait offset left + circular graphic frame right + teal/white high-key color palette + mixed-width sans-serif typography.
